{{Quote|A mandatory blackout is in progress. All citizens report the designated safe area. A mandatory blackout is in progress. All citizens report the designated safe area.|Announcement broadcast on Coruscant|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>}}
During the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], shortly after the [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|Bombing of the Coruscant power generator]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] issued '''mandatory blackouts''' across its [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in order to conserve power for the war effort. During one such blackout, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] was assaulted by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] and [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]].
